findings.title: Full-domain runs omit the master runner's required companion artifacts
evidence: prompts/MASTER_RUNNER_FULL_HARDENING.md:90-105 requires access_control_matrix.md, backup_restore_drill_plan.md, incident_tabletop_scenarios.md, branch_protection_recommendation.md, sbom_license_policy_recommendation.md, secret_rotation_runbook.md, release_notes_draft.md, changelog_draft.md
runs/falcon-20261004-fast-main-f9cb67d and runs/chat-20261004-full-develop-0695894 contain none of those companions
findings.impact: A run can pass `check_run.sh` while missing eight deliverables the master runner declares required, weakening the audit contract.
findings.recommendation: Have aggregate render each companion (even as an explicit N/A stub) or add them to the run schema and `check_run.sh`.

findings.title: publish_audit relabels any run as a focused security/supply-chain/CI pass
evidence: tools/publish_audit.py:324 always names the report lens_focused_security_supply_chain_ci.md
findings.impact: Publishing a full-domain run through the standard tool misstates its scope in the canonical `audit_manifest.json` and report name.
findings.recommendation: Derive profile/prompts/report name from the run's `audit_manifest.json` mode instead of hardcoding the focused set.

report: Mapped the full_domain driver features to the master runner's required outputs. `init/emit/aggregate/status/run` are implemented; verification mode and the master runner's companion artifacts are not.
